meta_description: Compute where the physics is — edge fabric for plants, stores, vehicles and grids.

blocks.x: Compute where the physics is — edge fabric for plants, stores, vehicles and grids.

When the decision lives at the machine — a vision inspection, a grid relay setting, a store kiosk — the cloud round trip is the architecture mistake. We engineer edge fabric: hardware selection and sizing for the environment (IP-rated, DIN-rail, GPU-capable), KubeEdge/K3s-class orchestration with fleet management, offline-first application patterns, model deployment pipelines with OTA updates, and store-and-forward telemetry that survives connectivity loss.

Security gets specific at the edge: physical tamper considerations, hardware roots of trust, signed images and measured boot, and network segmentation aligned to IEC 62443 zones-and-conduits for industrial estates. Fleet operations are the real product — thousands of nodes versioned, monitored and updated like a software estate, with SLOs per site.
